title: Unit 21 Consolidation: Economic Cycles, Crisis & Adaptation

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can say how many times something grew (-szorosára) and that two things are proportional (arányban áll)
I can describe a change with mértékben, ütemben and arányában
I can compare sizes (kétszer akkora) and say that something fell to a half or a third
I can write a short economic account with rates and balance
